messages:
Maya P.: Heads-up: launching a short manager verification sprint for the new handbook appendix on benefits eligibility. Need manager confirmations for edge cases (contractors, perm part-time, international hires) and final enrollment reconcile by EOD next Friday. :calendar:
Alex R.: Is this the same as the open-enroll refresh or a new doc?
Maya P.: New appendix. It focuses on eligibility nuances not covered in the main open-enrollment doc. Draft: https://redwood.intranet/handbook/appendix-benefits (draft).
Jon K.: Will loop in hiring managers. Do they need to upload supporting docs?
Maya P.: No upload required initially. Managers should set "manager_verified" = yes in the verification sheet. If there's an exception, tag the row with "benefits-exception" and add a short comment. Sheet: https://sheets.redwood.internal/benefits-verification-2026
Sasha L.: APAC gotcha: several legacy-plan hires. How should they be annotated?
Maya P.: Mark as "legacy_plan" in the flag column and add a reason in comments. We'll reconcile in a follow-up audit.
Emily T.: Can ops export enrollments as CSV to make bulk checks easier?
People Ops Bot: Export ready. Use:
````
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $HR_API_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/hr/enrollments?format=csv -o enrollments_3123456789.csv
````
Alex R.: I'll pull and attach to the sheet this afternoon. :white_check_mark:
Jon K.: Timeline check: managers have 7 business days after CSV posted to verify?
Maya P.: Correct. If no verification, defaults will apply and HR will follow up.
Sasha L.: Can you produce a one-page quick-reference for managers with the top-five edge cases?
Maya P.: Yes. Drafting a one-pager + a 6-step checklist. Will share before EOD.
Emily T.: How will microtraining completions be tracked?
Maya P.: LMS module: "Benefits Appendix — Eligibility clarifier (10 min)". Managers should confirm completions in the sheet; LMS completion events will post to the tracking webhook.
People Ops Bot: Reminder set for 3123456925 to nudge managers who haven't verified.
Alex R.: I'll nudge my managers in team channels too.
Maya P.: Action items: (1) Ops: export + attach CSV; (2) Managers: review sheet & mark manager_verified within 7 business days; (3) Everyone: complete LMS module; (4) People Ops: publish one-pager and reconcile legacy_plan rows. For ambiguous cases, open a ticket with tag "benefits-exception" using the template.
Jon K.: Exceptions: tickets only, right?
Maya P.: Yes — tickets only to maintain audit trail. Template: https://redwood.intranet/ops/tickets/benefits-exception-template
Sasha L.: Happy to help triage APAC legacy rows.
People Ops Bot: Acknowledged.
Maya P.: Thanks team — will post final appendix + checklist by EOD. :thumbsup:
